name: A Host of Evil
summary: Myriam Moonsinger asks you to confront Razorfen Downs’ defenders and cultists. Their presence is the problem she sends you to address.

sections.title: Myriam’s Request
sections.body: Near the entrance to Razorfen Downs, Myriam Moonsinger asks you to face the Razorfen Battleguard, Razorfen Thornweavers, and Death's Head Cultists within. She expects you to return to her after dealing with them.

faq.q: Who asks for help at Razorfen Downs?
faq.answer: Myriam Moonsinger, near the entrance to Razorfen Downs, asks you to confront its defenders and cultists.
Myriam names Razorfen Battleguard, Razorfen Thornweavers, and Death's Head Cultists.

faq.q: Where do I return to Myriam?
faq.answer: Return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
